mandatory_controls.name: Identity verification before activation
mandatory_controls.rule: An account cannot be activated until identity and company-document validation is complete.

mandatory_controls.name: Sanctions screening before activation
mandatory_controls.rule: A sanctions-screening result must exist before account activation.

mandatory_controls.name: High-risk manual approval
mandatory_controls.rule: A Risk Manager must approve every high-risk case before activation.

mandatory_controls.name: Controlled exception route
mandatory_controls.rule: A case with an unresolved exception cannot use the normal activation route.

mandatory_controls.name: Activation audit evidence
mandatory_controls.rule: The activation record must retain evidence of all applicable checks and approvals.

optimization_principles.statement: Information collected from the customer should be captured once and reused.
Independent checks may run in parallel when mandatory sequencing is preserved.
Every case and exception requires one visible accountable owner.
Automation may prepare or route work but cannot waive a mandatory control.
